# Pyraxis

> Pyraxis is a brand-building and digital studio based in Katy, Texas, founded by Raed Hassan Haidar. It builds brands with purpose and emotion for small businesses, working online with clients anywhere in the United States, in English and Spanish. Everything is made by hand (no templates) and delivered finished: published, working and owned by the client.

Pyraxis started with Ta-Umm Mediterranean Food, the Katy food truck run by Raed's family, which is also its testing ground: what works there is what Pyraxis brings to clients.

## Services

- Websites: premium bilingual (English/Spanish) one-page sites with animations, contact forms and direct WhatsApp orders.
- Digital brand audit: website, social media, offer, pricing, reviews and competitors, scored 0-100 with prioritized fixes.
- Logo and visual identity: logo, color palette, typography and usage guide.
- Full branding: identity, voice, messaging and applications.
- Content and positioning: editorial calendar, scripts and a publishing system.
- Automation and AI: assistants that answer customers, calculators, integrations and sales analysis.
- Custom apps: installable web apps with user accounts, subscription billing and built-in AI.
- Meta and Google ads, with tracking.

Every project is quoted individually. The service and pricing assistant is at https://pyraxisagency.com/pyra

## Portfolio

- [Ta-Umm Mediterranean Food](https://taummrestaurant.com): full brand, menus, trailer design, bilingual website with online ordering and DoorDash, Uber Eats and Grubhub integrations (Katy, TX).
- [A & H General Solutions](https://ahgeneral.pyraxisagency.com): bilingual website with an AI assistant and a solar savings calculator (Houston, TX).
- [Impulsa Tu Marca](https://impulsatumarcausa.com): website for international speaker Mary Claudia Andrade and her academy (Houston, TX).
- Panna Cottas Anto's: rebranding and website for an artisan dessert brand (Katy, TX).

## Pyraxis apps

- [Sapphire](https://sapphire.pyraxisagency.com): AI replies to Google, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub and Yelp reviews in each restaurant's voice.
- [Ruby](https://ruby.pyraxisagency.com): AI cost and pricing for small businesses from notes, voice or receipt photos.
- [Emerald](https://emerald.pyraxisagency.com): AI medical records for doctors and their patients.
